description: This PHP class defines the AddressFormat model for the OpenCart admin module. It provides methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting address format records in the database, along with support for filtering and counting records.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing address format records, including CRUD operations and retrieval of multiple records with filtering in the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addAddressFormat
methods.description: Creates a new address format record in the database.

methods.name: editAddressFormat
methods.description: Updates an existing address format record identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteAddressFormat
methods.description: Deletes an address format record from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getAddressFormat
methods.description: Retrieves a specific address format record by its ID.

methods.name: getAddressFormats
methods.description: Retrieves a list of address format records with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAddressFormats
methods.description: Returns the total number of address format records, possibly filtered.
